news.headline: Kiffin understands frustration as LSU's playoff hopes dashed
news.description: LSU coach Lane Kiffin said it was fair to question the team's 6-4 record this season after losing to Texas on Saturday, a defeat that likely knocked LSU out of playoff contention.

news.description: Saturday didn't offer much to change the season's complexion, but some coaches are coming under pressure.

news.headline: Arch Manning leads game-winning drive as Texas stuns LSU
news.description: Arch Manning found Raleek Brown for a 4-yard touchdown pass along the left sideline with 3 seconds left, and Texas escaped Tiger Stadium with a victory over LSU on Saturday night.

news.description: Louisville held off North Carolina 16-14 on Saturday night in a game that ended in a brawl and each of the teams having to be separated.

news.headline: Kentucky's CFP hopes take hit in upset loss to Gators, Philo
news.description: Florida quarterback Aaron Philo had 221 all-purpose yards and a touchdown to rally the Gators past No. 11 Kentucky 21-14 Saturday.

news.headline: No. 24 Boise State outlasts Oregon State, to host Pac-12 title game
news.description: Rasean Jones caught 11 passes for 230 yards and 3 TDs to help No. 24 Boise State outlast Oregon State 46-41 and wrap up the host spot in the Pac-12 title game.

news.headline: No. 16 Oregon keeps CFP hopes alive with win over Michigan
news.description: Dylan Raiola threw for 341 yards and four touchdowns, and No. 16 Oregon kept its slim chances for a spot in the College Football Playoff alive with a victory over struggling Michigan on Saturday.

wiki.title: Carter Smith (offensive tackle)
wiki.intro: Carter Smith (born April 15, 2004) is an American football offensive tackle for the Indiana Hoosiers.

sections.title: Early life
sections.text: Smith attended Olentangy Liberty High School in Powell, Ohio. He was rated as a four-star recruit and the 207th overall prospect in the class of 2022, and committed to play college football for the Indiana Hoosiers.

sections.title: College career
sections.text: As a freshman in 2022, Smith was redshirted after playing in two games. In 2023, he made all 12 starts at left tackle. After the season, Smith was rumored to enter the NCAA transfer portal but returned to the Hoosiers. In 2024, he started all 13 games at left tackle, earning honorable mention all-Big Ten honors.
